verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents an official CLI at docs/proxy/cli. The only cited detail is a server-launch flag (worker process count for uvicorn/gunicorn/Granian), so the CLI is evidenced as a way to start the proxy rather than a broad interactive or agent-friendly command surface. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands beyond proxy startup (e.g., key/model/team management, request invocation), machine-readable or agent-oriented output modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The number of worker processes to spin up (uvicorn, gunicorn, or Granian --workers).
